subject: Quick thought about the budget file
text:
Hi Alex,

Sorry for the rapid note, but the client just moved the review to Thursday morning, so I wanted to pass along a small thing before it becomes a bigger mess. If you are still putting together the budget summary, use the new category names from the revised tracker rather than the old labels in the first draft. I know that sounds minor, but the finance lead keeps comparing sheets column by column, and any mismatch gets treated like a serious reporting issue instead of a simple formatting problem. It is also worth adding one brief line under the travel total explaining that the figures changed after the vendor update. That tiny explanation can save you a round of questions, especially since nobody has time to chase context before Thursday. I am not asking you to redo anything major, just to glance over the headings and make sure the dates and totals are visible at the top. If you get stuck or want me to check the layout, send it over soon.
